sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
PayPal (Contract) – Senior Program Manager (TPMO - Technical Program Management Office) | Bengaluru, KA | October 2024 – Present
Technology & Tools: Jira, Smartsheet, ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Confluence
Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
•
Program leadership, ensuring business strategy is seamlessly integrated with product and engineering, resulting in achieving the desired business benefit.
• Managing around fifteen high-impact initiatives in the Credit Collections portfolio (Consumer, Merchant and Regulatory), driving
execution oversight throughout the program lifecycle, governance, and managing risks. Fostering cross-functional collaboration across Business, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Operational Excellence, Operations, and Vendor Management (including third-party), to achieve critical program milestones. Leading executive-level engagements, ensuring strategic alignment and cross-functional synergy to support business and operational priorities.
Optimizing resources, enhancing service delivery, and ensuring regulatory compliance by leveraging financial and operational insights
to drive efficiency, budget precision, and long-term business growth. Leading end-to-end Program Management for the Credit Collections portfolio, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with business objectives. Implementing robust tracking and governance mechanisms, ensuring transparency in project status, key milestones and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management, proactively identifying, and mitigating potential challenges to ensure program success.
Trianz Digital Consulting – Associate Director, Delivery | Bengaluru, KA | October 2021 – May 2023
Key Responsibilities & Achievements: •
Spearheaded the cloud migration from on-premise Netezza to Microsoft Azure to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.
Owned and managed a $3M annual revenue portfolio, driving delivery excellence across Data & Analytics accounts in the Insurance and
Reinsurance domains (Chubb). Led the turnaround of two high-risk, red-status accounts, successfully stabilizing operations, restoring client confidence, and securing contract renewals with additional headcount expansion. Played a pivotal role in pre-sales initiatives, contributing to a robust $15M sales pipeline through domain expertise and strategic client engagements.
Governance & Agile Leadership: • Account Management & Leadership Reviews – Oversaw growth strategy, profitability, staffing, risk & issue management across
multiple accounts. Change & Risk Management – Led quality assurance, root-cause analysis, and risk mitigation to ensure smooth and efficient project execution. Financial & Contract Governance – Managed contract negotiations, invoice management, and commercial oversight to align financials with delivery objectives. Client Engagement & Strategic Partnerships – Maintained a continuous feedback loop with client leadership, fostering transparency, trust, and long-term collaboration.
Technology & Tools: • • • • Database & BI Tools: MS SQL Server, Data Quality, Power BI
Agile/DevOps: Jira, Microsoft Project Cloud & Data Platforms: Azure Cloud, Enterprise Data Warehouse, Data Mart ETL & Data Integration: Netezza, Informatica IICS, Informatica 10.2.1
Impact & Value Delivered: By driving data-driven digital transformation in the Insurance & Reinsurance sector, successfully delivered scalable analytics solutions, enhanced data quality, and enabled clients to make informed business decisions—leading to revenue growth, operational stability, and long-term client trust.
Genpact Headstrong Capital Markets – Sr. Manager (Senior Principal Consultant) | Bengaluru | July 2017 – Sep 2021
Key Responsibilities & Achievements: • Owned and managed a $10M annual revenue portfolio, overseeing the delivery of all accounts within the FinTech domain (PayPal). • Drove exponential growth in a key FinTech account, scaling revenue from $2.5M to $8M through consistent delivery excellence.
Established an Offshore Development Centre (ODC) and streamlined delivery processes to enhance efficiency. Successfully turned around a high-risk, red-status account in the transportation domain, stabilizing operations, restoring customer confidence, and securing a contract renewal. Actively contributed to pre-sales initiatives, leveraging deep domain expertise to drive new business opportunities.
Governance & Agile Leadership: •
Internal Leadership Reviews – Oversaw account management, including growth strategy, margin optimization, staffing, risk & issue management.
Agile & Scrum Best Practices:
o Facilitated daily standups to ensure alignment and progress tracking. o Led sprint planning, protecting teams from scope creep and ensuring realistic commitments. o Engaged in sprint reviews, capturing valuable stakeholder feedback for iterative improvements. o Conducted retrospectives, identifying key areas for continuous improvement. • Risk & Issue Management, Root-Cause Analysis, and Change Management to ensure high-quality deliveries. • Contract & Invoice Management, ensuring seamless financial and operational alignment with client expectations. • Maintained an ongoing client leadership review & feedback loop to drive transparency and sustained collaboration.
Technology & Tools: Product Development Stack: • •
Agile/DevOps: Rally, Kanban, CI/CD, GitLab, TeamCity, Octopus Cloud & Backend: Azure Cloud, PostgreSQL, .NET, Java, NodeJS, Python
• • • UX/UI Design: Sketch, Adobe XD, Illustrator • Mobile Development: iOS, Android
Frontend & Mobile: ReactJS, Angular (Ionic), JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dreamweaver Automation & QA: Selenium, Galen
Impact & Value Delivered: By combining deep FinTech domain expertise, strong governance, and agile best practices, successfully delivered scalable, high-impact solutions that improved customer confidence, drove revenue growth, and ensured seamless digital transformations for global clients. Wipro Technologies – Project / Program Manager | Bengaluru, KA | Aug 2000 – July 2017
Client: Thames Water, UK | Domain: Utilities | Program: Sample Manager Upgrade (LIMS - Lab Information Management System) (Fixed- Price Project) | Role: Program Manager
Key Responsibilities: •
Spearheaded the platform migration from a legacy infrastructure & application version to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.
Upgraded the Sample Manager application (a Platinum CoS application) alongside the infrastructure to align with the latest technology standards & led governance reporting, change management, and risk management, and conducted root cause analysis to ensure seamless project execution. Tools & Technology: Sample Manager v11, SQL, Windows Infrastructure, Microsoft Project
Key Achievements: •
Successfully led and delivered a high-value £800K fixed-price program, ensuring all milestones were met on time with full payment received. Achieved an outstanding 7/7 customer satisfaction rating. Effectively collaborated with multiple third-party vendors, including Thermo Fisher and Primary/Secondary Data Centres in London.
•
Client: Shell | Domain: Energy | Program: Upstream – IMASD (Managed Services) | Role: Project Manager (Application Support & Maintenance) | Tools & Technology: Livelink (OpenText) Key Responsibilities: • Managed and delivered multiple projects under IMASD, focusing on maintenance, enhancements, and support for critical applications,
including: o EP Livelink o EP Online Portal o Orchestra o EP Records Management o
SharePoint PDT
Oversaw governance reporting, change management, and risk management, and performed root cause analysis to enhance system efficiency and reliability.

PayPal (Contract) – Senior Program Manager (TPMO - Technical Program Management Office) | Bengaluru, KA | October 2024 – Present
Technology & Tools: Jira, Smartsheet, ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Confluence
Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
•
Program leadership, ensuring business strategy is seamlessly integrated with product and engineering, resulting in achieving the desired business benefit.
• Managing around fifteen high-impact initiatives in the Credit Collections portfolio (Consumer, Merchant and Regulatory), driving
execution oversight throughout the program lifecycle, governance, and managing risks. Fostering cross-functional collaboration across Business, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Operational Excellence, Operations, and Vendor Management (including third-party), to achieve critical program milestones. Leading executive-level engagements, ensuring strategic alignment and cross-functional synergy to support business and operational priorities.
Optimizing resources, enhancing service delivery, and ensuring regulatory compliance by leveraging financial and operational insights
to drive efficiency, budget precision, and long-term business growth. Leading end-to-end Program Management for the Credit Collections portfolio, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with business objectives. Implementing robust tracking and governance mechanisms, ensuring transparency in project status, key milestones and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management, proactively identifying, and mitigating potential challenges to ensure program success.

logical_blocks.text:
Trianz Digital Consulting – Associate Director, Delivery | Bengaluru, KA | October 2021 – May 2023
Key Responsibilities & Achievements: •
Spearheaded the cloud migration from on-premise Netezza to Microsoft Azure to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.
Owned and managed a $3M annual revenue portfolio, driving delivery excellence across Data & Analytics accounts in the Insurance and
Reinsurance domains (Chubb). Led the turnaround of two high-risk, red-status accounts, successfully stabilizing operations, restoring client confidence, and securing contract renewals with additional headcount expansion. Played a pivotal role in pre-sales initiatives, contributing to a robust $15M sales pipeline through domain expertise and strategic client engagements.
 • Account Management & Leadership Reviews – Oversaw growth strategy, profitability, staffing, risk & issue management across
multiple accounts. Change & Risk Management – Led quality assurance, root-cause analysis, and risk mitigation to ensure smooth and efficient project execution. Financial & Contract Governance – Managed contract negotiations, invoice management, and commercial oversight to align financials with delivery objectives. Client Engagement & Strategic Partnerships – Maintained a continuous feedback loop with client leadership, fostering transparency, trust, and long-term collaboration.
 • • • • Database & BI Tools: MS SQL Server, Data Quality, Power BI
Agile/DevOps: Jira, Microsoft Project Cloud & Data Platforms: Azure Cloud, Enterprise Data Warehouse, Data Mart ETL & Data Integration: Netezza, Informatica IICS, Informatica 10.2.1
By driving data-driven digital transformation in the Insurance & Reinsurance sector, successfully delivered scalable analytics solutions, enhanced data quality, and enabled clients to make informed business decisions—leading to revenue growth, operational stability, and long-term client trust.

Genpact Headstrong Capital Markets – Sr. Manager (Senior Principal Consultant) | Bengaluru | July 2017 – Sep 2021
Key Responsibilities & Achievements: • Owned and managed a $10M annual revenue portfolio, overseeing the delivery of all accounts within the FinTech domain (PayPal). • Drove exponential growth in a key FinTech account, scaling revenue from $2.5M to $8M through consistent delivery excellence.
Established an Offshore Development Centre (ODC) and streamlined delivery processes to enhance efficiency. Successfully turned around a high-risk, red-status account in the transportation domain, stabilizing operations, restoring customer confidence, and securing a contract renewal. Actively contributed to pre-sales initiatives, leveraging deep domain expertise to drive new business opportunities.

o Facilitated daily standups to ensure alignment and progress tracking. o Led sprint planning, protecting teams from scope creep and ensuring realistic commitments. o Engaged in sprint reviews, capturing valuable stakeholder feedback for iterative improvements. o Conducted retrospectives, identifying key areas for continuous improvement. • Risk & Issue Management, Root-Cause Analysis, and Change Management to ensure high-quality deliveries. • Contract & Invoice Management, ensuring seamless financial and operational alignment with client expectations. • Maintained an ongoing client leadership review & feedback loop to drive transparency and sustained collaboration.
Technology & Tools: Product Development Stack: • •
Agile/DevOps: Rally, Kanban, CI/CD, GitLab, TeamCity, Octopus Cloud & Backend: Azure Cloud, PostgreSQL, .NET, Java, NodeJS, Python
• • • UX/UI Design: Sketch, Adobe XD, Illustrator • Mobile Development: iOS, Android
Frontend & Mobile: ReactJS, Angular (Ionic), JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dreamweaver Automation & QA: Selenium, Galen
By combining deep FinTech domain expertise, strong governance, and agile best practices, successfully delivered scalable, high-impact solutions that improved customer confidence, drove revenue growth, and ensured seamless digital transformations for global clients.
